question: What benefit do recitation and worship bring to one who remains spiritually bound?
premises: He may still perform recitation and worship
The value of these acts is questioned
inference: Recitation and worship are of no real benefit to one who remains bound in ignorance.
uncertainties: siktaḥ may also suggest being sprinkled or affected; taken here as bound/fettered in context
plain_english: O fair-limbed one, he becomes bound; what use are recitation and worship for him?
